$comment: Template for a project's documented ignore list. Copy into the project's browser-qa-manifest.json. EVERY entry needs a justification and an owner. An empty list is the correct default (BROWSER-REGRESSION-QA-PROTOCOL.md sec 9, sec 10).

console_ignore.justification: Emitted only in dev builds; production bundle does not print it. Verified in the production build inspection dated 2026-08-29.

allowed_third_party_failures.justification: Optional social embed. Site is fully functional when it fails; failure is designed for. Declared in security-privacy-review.md sec 9.
